WoW: Forever · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Written for levelling, 1 to 60. Forever's beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Mage build has been tested. Ability training levels below come from foreverchanges.pro's reading of the beta client. Note that caster base damage was cut across the board and spell coefficients raised to compensate, a lower tooltip number than Classic is usually not a nerf. Neither Wowhead nor ClassicWoW.gg publishes a levelling score for the three specs. Icy Veins is the only one of the three that rates them, and it gives both a number out of five and a heading; those are reported on each spec's own page.

The three specs do different things. Arcane is the genuinely new one: Forever gave it Arcane BlastArcane BlastLevel 20 · Spell · ArcaneCast2.5 sec castRange30 yd range and Missile BarrageMissile BarrageTalentCastInstant, neither of which existed in Classic, and Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalentCastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. at 50% mana regeneration while casting against Classic's 15% — Icy Veins names that talent as what "significantly reduces downtime between fights". Fire is the critical-strike spec: Heating UpHeating UpTalentCastInstant from 25 makes PyroblastPyroblastLevel 20 · Spell · FireCast6 sec castCost125 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration12 sec castable inside a fight, and IgniteIgniteTalentCastInstant returns 40% of a spell's damage again over 4 seconds. Frost freezes: FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstant gives every Chill effect a chance to lock the target down, and Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. hits a frozen target for +300%.

Each spec page carries Icy Veins' levelling score and its heading for that spec, which is the only rating any of the three tracked sources publishes.

One claim worth flagging rather than stating flat: none of the three sources confirms or denies a target cap or damage falloff on Mage area spells in Forever. Treat that as genuinely open rather than settled either way. The slows attached to area damage were cut hard, though; Improved BlizzardImproved BlizzardTalentCastInstant maxes at 40%, down from Classic's 65% (ClassicWoW.gg's talent tooltip: rank 3 reads "lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec").

Is Mage for you?

Play Mage if you want burst damage from range and can accept cloth armour, no self-heal and a mana bar you have to manage. (Our own reading, not a source's.)

Strengths

  • Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. hits a frozen target for +300%, and Heating UpHeating UpTalentCastInstant makes PyroblastPyroblastLevel 20 · Spell · FireCast6 sec castCost125 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration12 sec castable inside a fight from 25
  • Conjures its own drink from level 4 and food from level 6, so neither is ever bought
  • PolymorphPolymorphLevel 8 · Spell · ArcaneCast1.5 sec castCost60 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration20 secTransforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters. at level 8 takes one enemy out of a fight entirely

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? The published level 20 rotations run five or six steps: a nuke, a freeze, a retreat, a wand finish.

Is it forgiving? No. You have cloth armour, no self-heal, and mana that does not regenerate while you cast.

What carries you while levelling? Conjured drink from level 4 and food from level 6, so you buy neither, and PolymorphPolymorphLevel 8 · Spell · ArcaneCast1.5 sec castCost60 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration20 secTransforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters. from 8 takes one enemy out of a fight.

Does it need a group? No. Every spec has a published solo build, and Arcane and Frost also have published dungeon variants.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation, and no race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Where racials genuinely decide things is PvP, and specifically the ones that break crowd control: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead, fear, sleep and charm), Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. (Gnome, roots and snares) and StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases the caster's armor by 20 for 15 sec. (Dwarf, bleeds, poisons and disease). A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below.

Alliance — Human or Gnome. Human's Sword SpecializationSword SpecializationTalentCastInstantDurationUntil cancelledIncreases your damage with One-Handed Swords by 1. is +2% spell and ability crit off a sword held purely as a stat stick, which is a real change to the vanilla answer, though compare it honestly against a staff with better stats, because at levelling levels the staff often wins. Gnome brings Expansive MindExpansive MindTalentCastInstantMaximum Mana increased by 5%. and Eureka!Eureka!TalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 sec, but as of October 1 Eureka!Eureka!TalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 sec no longer benefits periodic effects at all — a channeled cast like Arcane MissilesArcane MissilesLevel 8 · Spell · ArcaneCastInstantCost85 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration3 secLaunches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 24 Arcane damage each second for 3 sec. or EvocationEvocationLevel 20 · Spell · ArcaneCastInstantCooldown480 sec cooldownDuration8 secWhile channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500%. Lasts 8 sec. doesn't count as a periodic, so those still get the bonus, but a damage-over-time tick (Fire's IgniteIgniteTalentCastInstant, for instance) no longer does. (Known issue: Eureka currently doesn't affect every damaging or healing spell for some classes; Blizzard says it's fixed in a later build.)

Horde — Orc is new to Mage in Forever, and Blood FuryBlood FuryTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec. now gives +10% spell power, so it is finally a caster racial. Its axe racial is dead weight, since Mages cannot use axes.

Skyborne Mage is Alliance-only. Troll's BerserkingBerserkingTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration10 sec is now a flat +10% cast speed, and Undead's CannibalizeCannibalizeTalentCastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown120 sec cooldown restores mana as well as health.

Quality of life

  • Conjured water is free drink from level 4, upgrading through the gem ladder, so there is never a reason to buy it.
  • Teleports come from a separate portal trainer standing near your class trainer, and every teleport consumes a Rune of Teleportation at about nine and a half silver. Slow FallSlow FallLevel 12 · Spell · ArcaneCastInstantCost40 ManaDuration30 secSlows falling speed for 30 sec. eats a Light Feather per cast, carry a stack of both.
  • Pick up books from level 6. Forever's new Research system unlocks from finding books in the world and returning them to librarians, and it pays real gear, a ring for twenty book donations, and a pendant from its quest. Failing to decipher a scroll turns you into a sheep until your skill improves. (Known issue, October 1: some Mages who learn Research find themselves locked out of accessing it — that's a bug, not something you did; it's worth knowing before you chase it early.)
  • Every Comprehension scroll lost move-casting on October 1. All Mage scrolls from the Research system had a balance pass and can no longer be cast while moving — budget the stand-still time like any other cast.
  • Get a wand early and use it instead of Fire BlastFire BlastLevel 6 · Spell · FireCastInstantCost40 ManaRange20 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownBlasts the enemy for 28 Fire damage..

At level 60

Unknown. No source publishes a Mage build past 30, so whether Arcane's new engine holds up, whether Fire takes over once Pyroblast is usable, and how far the scroll system goes are all untested. Raids open December 9.
